per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system SHALL integrate directly with the Choice Parts feed so that availability and part data are current without requiring manual exports or copy/paste.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall interface with the Choice Parts System. This provides the feed of recycled parts data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Parts search responses SHALL be returned within 15 seconds or less under normal conditions as perceived by the user.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Facility (repair shop) search responses SHALL be returned within 8 seconds or less under normal conditions as perceived by the user.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for the preferred repair facility shall take no longer than 8 seconds. The preferred repair facility is returned within 8 seconds'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Audit reports about recycled-parts usage SHALL be generated and returned within 10 seconds or less so the user can review them before continuing work.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The recycled parts audit report shall be returned to the user within 10 seconds. The audit report shall be returned within 10 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application SHALL provide in-context help on the vast majority of screens (approximately 90% of screens) so users can find guidance without leaving their current workflow.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The user shall easily locate instructions while using the product. User help can be found within 90% of the system.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The UI SHALL adhere to the company's corporate UI guidelines (layout, colors, controls) to match the look-and-feel of other corporate apps.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall comply with corporate User Interface Guidelines'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system SHALL be usable on laptops, tablets, and phones, and SHALL provide offline or degraded-mode access to recent searches and core viewing capabilities when network connectivity is poor.
The application SHALL tolerate intermittent network connectivity and not crash on tablets or phones when connectivity is poor.
The system SHALL support concurrent use by multiple adjusters and handle peak loads (e.g., lunch rush) without unacceptable degradation of response times.
The system SHALL enforce strict data isolation so that each insurance company’s claims and customer data are accessible only to authorized users of that company.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'One insurance company shall not be able to view another insurance companys claim data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system SHALL implement role-based access control so users see data and functions appropriate to their role (e.g., program admins and regional managers have full access; site coordinators and junior adjusters have limited access).
The system SHALL achieve at least 98% uptime over a representative measurement period (e.g., monthly or annually).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall achieve a 98% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2% of the available online time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system SHALL provide undo or easy correction mechanisms so that users can recover from input mistakes without needing extensive support.
The system SHALL provide notifications to users when a part’s status changes to avoid manual polling.

Ratings and notes for repair shops SHALL be visible during shop selection and SHALL be stored so patterns of poor behavior can be identified; extreme negative ratings SHALL be able to exclude a shop from preferred lists.

The system SHALL avoid requiring lengthy training; core functionality SHALL be learnable with approximately two days of onsite hands-on training and basic tasks should be discoverable without extended instruction.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to learn by Adjusters and Collision Estimators. The product shall be learned with two days onsite training'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system SHALL provide auditability and traceability for recycled-parts usage in estimates, with reports that are easy to generate and review.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The recycled parts audit report shall be returned to the user within 10 seconds. The audit report shall be returned within 10 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system SHALL include mechanisms to prevent or minimize stale data caused by manual exports, e.g., automated synchronization or real-time integration with authoritative sources.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall interface with the Choice Parts System. This provides the feed of recycled parts data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system SHALL provide mechanisms to surface timely visibility (scores/notes) about repair shops so adjusters can make informed choices and reduce back-and-forth.
